unchanged_experiment.controls: Raw and fixed K1 share exact same rows/targets/preprocessing with both heads. Shuffle changes only complete label-map assignment. No GT, labels, source/profile/severity metadata or K1 output enters head.forward.
unchanged_experiment.features: exact frozen HistoryUtilityGate.features; no new features or geometry changes
unchanged_experiment.restorer: frozen final teacher K1, no restorer update

pretraining_required: All interface tests in proposal pass; preserve-input signed-zero ties are byte-exact; target/metadata are absent from network inputs.
Train19-only final-K1 cache: exactly16000 existing rows and1000 batch forwards; full frozen teacher/row/source/array/feature SHA audit and no restorer backward/update.
Whole-map shuffle is a strict source-and-group-excluded bijection within declared strata; infeasible strata stop both arms without fallback.
Dev cache reconstructs exact K3 bytes against original observation hashes for all2880 rows. No missing-neighbor fallback or new restorer output.

Freeze this comparative rule, metric implementation/weights/range and CPU backend before either1000-step head run. Two-candidate input/K1 oracle may be reported in the same preparation pass, but cannot pass the actual-head gate or determine thresholds.

screen.aggregation: First mean96frames within each(source,native profile); then equal3native profiles within source; then equal6sources. Identity and near_clean separate, equal6sources. Never pool controls to manufacture native improvement.

controls.coverage: Report corrected-tile and actual changed-pixel fractions per source/profile/phase for both heads, with native mean strictly between0and1. Near-clean has no arbitrary correction cap: judge actual harm, not low coverage alone.
controls.identity: Mean MAE(matched,target)<=0.05/255, every-source MAE<=0.10/255, and mean strictly below K1. Identity corrected-tile fraction<=0.05. Raw identity error is zero: do not demand a negative error or report infinite PSNR as evidence of a gain.
controls.near_clean: Mean MAE(matched)-MAE(raw)<=0.05/255; every-source harm<=0.10/255; mean MAE(matched)<=MAE(K1).

screen.decision: All numeric/integrity gates plus complete LPIPS/PSNR/coverage/boundary/flip evidence => eligible_for_next_bounded_fullframe_validation, never quality_proven. Any failed gate => failed_dev_screen; missing required metric or unresolved seam regression => pending_review. Do not adjust threshold/features/steps/checkpoint or rerun automatically.

native_MAE.guardrails: No equal-source native profile mean worse than K1; worst source native MAE harm relative to K1 <=0.05/255.
native_MAE.raw_restoration_retained: E(raw)>E(matched) and retained_gain=(E(raw)-E(matched))/(E(raw)-E(K1))>=0.95, with positive baseline denominator. Report this even though aggregate superiority to K1 makes it redundant; bypass-all fails.
native_MAE.source_support: At least4/6 sources have strictly positive gain versus K1; at least4/6 separately versus shuffle. Publish all6 paired values; these counts are not significance tests.
native_MAE.threshold_rationale: 0.01/255 and0.05/255 are proposed small, explicit engineering margins; they are neither utility-label normalization nor empirically calibrated perceptual/statistical thresholds. Freeze before training or replace prospectively; do not tune them after outputs.

perceptual_and_boundaries.LPIPS: Required, pinned identical implementation/weights, complete2880rows×4arms. Native mean matched no worse than K1 or shuffled by more than0.001; identity/near_clean each no worse than raw by more than0.001. Proposed engineering noninferiority margin, not a calibrated perceptual threshold. Missing/partial LPIPS => pending, not passed.
perceptual_and_boundaries.PSNR: Required descriptive per-source/profile/control MSE and PSNR. Source/profile PSNR is -10log10(mean frame MSE); native macro averages finite source/profile PSNR. For exact identity, represent infinite PSNR as null plus exact_match=true, never average infinities. Native macro PSNR must not be lower than K1 by more than0.05dB.
perceptual_and_boundaries.seams: Required actual RGB residual-gradient jump at internal16pixel tile boundaries relative to raw/K1, all source/profile/phase values. If the source-balanced native jump exceeds both raw and K1, mark requires_review and block automatic progression; no smoothing or threshold repair in this run.
perceptual_and_boundaries.temporal: Required stride1 mask flip rate on all95adjacent pairs per source/profile and separate declared degradation transitions. Report masks/outputs of both heads. This measures decisions, not flow-aligned flicker; no temporal-quality pass from this statistic.

screen.primary_arrays: Actual clipped deployment RGB for raw/K1/matched/shuffled. Additionally publish unclamped MAE/MSE and clipping rates; unclamped MAE gain versus K1 and shuffle must not reverse sign. LPIPS uses clipped RGB mapped to [-1,1] only.
screen.scope: One selected6dev/96center-crop screening run. No independent test or full-frame/streaming quality claim.

bounded_evaluation.LPIPS_note: LPIPS is an additional perceptual model computation, not zero model calls. Its bounded metric runtime/weight pins must be declared before admission; do not silently omit or replace it.

scope: Even a dev pass is one seed pair on6 repeatedly inspected development sources. Fresh source-disjoint evaluation/full-frame inference and separately bounded repeated seeds are future work, not requirements claimed completed here.
implementation_required: Metric formulas, all weight/source pins, exact CPU backend and finite run resources still must be implemented and frozen before training. No additional user confirmation is needed for authorized bounded work; these are technical readiness checks.
